# TEST-ONLY certificates

Generated by `judge-deployment/pki/pki.sh fixtures` (copied from oj-api-gateway's `src/test/resources/tls/`), valid
10 years, signed by a throwaway "My-OJ Test CA" whose key was discarded. They protect nothing and must never be used
outside tests. Production certificates are issued by `pki.sh issue-all` and never enter git.

- `ca.crt`: the test CA
- `server.*`: a server leaf (CN=localhost, SAN localhost / 127.0.0.1): the worker's /metrics server in the tests
- `tls-probe.*`: a client leaf signed by the CA (a scraper presenting a certificate)
